summary: Removed one duplicated entry from the interface account's limitations list, which my previous edit had introduced by appending a statement already present; no wording changed and nothing else was touched, so the recorded fixes for the stale counterevidence item and the knowledge-use revision stand. No execution was requested. Thirteen knowledge entries capture the reusable Behaviours and Facts behind those accounts, most of them about voter eligibility, election timing and configuration discipline. With about twenty-five minutes left I have no open measurement and no fresh sourced suspicion in hand, so rather than manufacture one I am leaving the record as it stands; if a subsequent turn finds a concrete new lead I would rather spend the time there than on further repetition.
